article.title: Husband or relative of husband of a woman subjecting her to cruelty
article.content:
85Husband or relative of husband of a woman subjecting her to cruelty

Section 85 · Chapter V · Of offences relating to marriage
Whoever, being the husband or the relative of the husband of a woman, subjects such woman to cruelty shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years and shall also be liable to fine.
